title: Accelerating Scientific Research with Gemini in the Real-World
abstract: arXiv:2608.26701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present an extension and comprehensive real-world validation of Co-Scientist, a Gemini-based multi-agent system designed to accelerate end-to-end scientific research across hypothesis generation, experimentation, and manuscript generation. Moving beyond in silico hypothesis generation, this specialized configuration transitions Co-Scientist into an execution-grounded research partner advancing closed-loop scientific workflows across materials science, biology, and computer science. In materials science, Co-Scientist interfaced with a semi-automated chemical vapor deposition reactor to design a safe precursor route for MXenes; experimental execution produced a lamellar 2D material sharing key structural similarities with the Ti3C2Tx MXene lattice, although further experiments are needed to confirm the atomic structure. translated_title: 利用Gemini加速现实世界中的科学研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26701v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了Co-Scientist的扩展和全面的现实世界验证，这是一个基于Gemini的多智能体系统，旨在加速从假设生成、实验执行到手稿撰写的端到端科学研究。超越纯计算机模拟的假设生成，这种专门配置将Co-Scientist转变为一种基于执行的研究伙伴，推动材料科学、生物学和计算机科学领域的闭环科学工作流程。在材料科学中，Co-Scientist与半自动化化学气相沉积反应器接口，设计了一种安全的MXene前驱体路线；实验执行产生了层状二维材料，其结构特征与Ti3C2Tx MXene晶格具有关键相似性，尽管仍需进一步实验以确认原子结构。利用Gemini 3 Deep Think进行快速的实验室循环执行，它还根据实验室条件定制了生长配方。
tldr: 本文展示了Co-Scientist系统在现实世界中的扩展验证，通过结合半自动化实验设备，实现了从假设生成到实验执行的闭环科学工作流，并在材料科学中成功设计了MXene的安全合成路线。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an extended real-world validation of the Co-Scientist system, which integrates semi-automated experimental equipment to achieve closed-loop scientific workflows from hypothesis generation to experimental execution, and successfully designs a safe synthesis route for MXenes in materials science.
